features: Medha visual identity: brown and amber palette, logo, sidebar workspace layout, light and dark modes
Medha page set: dashboard, tables, forms with validation, cards, calendar, editors, sign-in and error pages

structure.src/components/medha: Medha layout and UI components (sidebar, topbar, panels, metric cards)
structure.src/styles/medha: Medha theme CSS and design tokens

sections.title: Design system
sections.body:
Every screen uses the Medha theme. Colours, spacing and typography come from the `--medha-*` design tokens in `src/styles/medha/`; components in `src/components/medha/` provide the sidebar, topbar, panels and metric cards.

- Build new screens from the existing Medha components before writing new markup.
- Never hard-code colours or add another UI kit. `{{ runScript }} check:style` fails the build when a file does.
